name: jira_search
description: Searches the Jira issues this assistant may read with a JQL query, shows one issue in full given its key, or, with neither, lists the projects (boards) it may use and what it may do in each: read, change, or change after the user's Approve click. Use it when the user asks which issues exist, what is assigned, open or blocked, needs a key they do not know, or asks what an issue says (status, assignee, labels, parent, description, links, last 10 comments); before commenting, updating or deleting; and when they ask which projects exist. It changes nothing. Returns one line per issue (KEY | status | type | assignee | summary), the issue in full, or one line per project (KEY | name | type | what you may do).

jql.description: JQL filter as the user described it (e.g. status = "In Progress" ORDER BY updated DESC). When the assistant may read every project, include the project (e.g. project = PROJ AND status = Open). Leave it and key out to list the projects.

limit.description: How many issues (up to 50, default 20) or projects (up to 200, default 100) to show (e.g. 20).

key.description: Issue key to read in full (e.g. PROJ-123); leave jql out when you give it.

examples.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC
